$about: f00098 S4 — CLI↔UI parity contract. Every CLI command group maps to a UI affordance ({ kind: vscode-command | vscode-view | web-route, id }) or carries a documented waiver; every contributed VS Code command maps to a CLI counterpart (command or group) or carries a waiver. Enforced by tools/scripts/lint/cli-ui-parity.script.ts (bun run lint:cli-ui-parity).

adopt.waiver: f00170: read-only adoption assessment (detect stack, recommend plugins, estimate tool-schema cost) for the terminal/agent onboarding flow; no interactive UI story planned

ui.note: f00119 S6: surfaces auto_status + (optional) auto_recommend; pin via the CLI or delendai.openConfigurationCenter

audit.waiver: agent-workflow audit planner; terminal/agent surface only, no interactive UI story planned

completion.waiver: shell-only: prints bash/zsh/fish completion scripts, meaningless inside a UI host

conventions.waiver: repo-convention ratchet consumed by agents and lint gates; no interactive UI story planned

deps.waiver: dependency introspection for agents; terminal-first, no UI story planned

doctor.waiver: sectioned terminal health report with exit codes for scripts/CI; the dashboard is the interactive equivalent

fs.waiver: IDE-native: the editor and file explorer supersede fs read/write inside a UI host

git.waiver: IDE-native: VS Code's built-in SCM view supersedes the read-only git group

init.waiver: global/project IDE configuration bootstrap; terminal-first setup flow with no interactive UI story planned

init:global.waiver: global IDE configuration bootstrap; terminal-first setup flow with no separate interactive UI story planned

init:default.waiver: non-interactive bootstrap for scripts and fresh checkouts; shell-only by design

logs.waiver: log query/tail/correlate is terminal-first; no dedicated log view contributed yet

notification.waiver: agent-coordination primitive (status/await-lock); not a human UI affordance

ui.note: the dashboard lists loaded plugins and their tools

project.waiver: project analyze/plan/create is an agent scaffolding surface; terminal-first, no UI story planned

quality.waiver: quality scope runner is terminal-first; the validate group carries the UI affordance (runValidation)

rules.waiver: rules engine consumed by agents and lint gates; terminal-first, no UI story planned

router-dashboard.waiver: f00140 S2 surfaces the recommendation + spend table as a CLI command (auto_status + auto_recommend + usage_report); the HTML webview renderer (S3) is staged for a future slice that wires it to a `vscode-view` command.

scaffold.waiver: code generator that writes workspace files; terminal-first, no UI story planned

search.waiver: IDE-native: VS Code's built-in workspace search supersedes CLI text search

security.waiver: secret + dependency-CVE + license posture scanning for agents and CI; terminal-first, a VS Code posture panel is future work

status-marker.waiver: swarm status-marker protocol between agents; not a human UI affordance

test-convention.waiver: test-convention scanner for agents; terminal-first, no UI story planned

ui.note: f00098 S3: the provider dashboard renders the usage-cost card (usage_report + advise_spend)
the validation command surfaces the configured matrix

web-fetch.waiver: agent web-fetch primitive; the IDE host has native browsing, no UI story planned

delendai.openAutoAgentSelector.note: f00119 S6: surfaces auto_status + (optional) auto_recommend; pin via the CLI or delendai.openConfigurationCenter

delendai.openAgentCatalog.note: the agent catalog is the overview snapshot rendered as a webview

delendai.openAgentTimeline.waiver: VS Code-only observability viewer for the persisted agent timeline; no standalone CLI timeline command is registered yet

delendai.openRuntimeLog.waiver: VS Code-only runtime log viewer; the CLI exposes log querying but no equivalent command opens the persisted viewer

delendai.openDashboardTab.note: same dashboard as delendai.openDashboard, opened in an editor tab instead of the side panel; one CLI counterpart serves both placements

delendai.providers.openDashboard.note: f00098 S3: the panel's usage card is the report; the provider half wraps agent tools (healthcheck_providers/get_quota) with no CLI group

delendai.providers.healthcheck.waiver: wraps the agent tool orchestrator-runner healthcheck_providers; the orchestrator has no CLI group (agent/MCP-first surface)

delendai.providers.pause.waiver: wraps the agent tool set_provider_state (manual availability override); no CLI group for the orchestrator yet

delendai.providers.resume.waiver: wraps the agent tool set_provider_state (manual availability override); no CLI group for the orchestrator yet

delendai.usage.clear.note: both surfaces confirm: the CLI needs --confirm, the command shows a modal

delendai.refresh.waiver: UI refresh affordance; re-running the corresponding CLI command is the scriptable equivalent

delendai.proposals.refresh.waiver: view-title refresh button for the proposals view; UI mechanics only

delendai.proposals.copyError.waiver: clipboard affordance for the proposals view error state; UI mechanics only

delendai.toolSearch.note: overview --full prints the complete tool map; fuzzy filtering is UI-side sugar

delendai.openToolDetail.note: tool leaf detail view combines overview/listTools schemas and metrics for one tool

delendai.restartServer.waiver: extension-host process lifecycle; the CLI is a client of that server and cannot restart the host's instance

delendai.plugins.activation.note: f00107 S3: overview activation report plus merge-aware config enabled toggles

delendai.openConfigurationCenter.note: schema-driven project configuration editor; config show is the read-only terminal counterpart

delendai.saveSettings.note: internal settings-webview save handler; hidden from the command palette

delendai.resetSettings.note: internal settings-webview reset handler; hidden from the command palette

delendai.openToolbar.waiver: UI navigation into the webview toolbar; no scriptable behaviour

delendai.setupGithub.waiver: guided IDE onboarding flow for GitHub issues; no CLI counterpart yet

delendai.externalMcps.ack.waiver: f00068 S5: wraps the external-mcps plugin's external_mcp_ack tool (human accept/reject of an external-server activation); the external-mcps discovery/ack surface is agent/MCP-first with no CLI group

delendai.startServerUntrusted.waiver: x00072 SEC-001 S1: manual override that spawns the stdio child in an untrusted workspace after the user reads the warning. No CLI counterpart (CLI refuses untrusted workspaces entirely); the gate is purely a VS Code affordance.

delendai.openPluginConfig.note: f00098: reuses Configuration Center (config show is the read-only CLI counterpart) with optional pluginId narrowing
